Frontalis muscle
parts.action: Raises the eyebrows and wrinkles the forehead.
parts.insertion: Skin of the eyebrows and forehead

parts.name: Occipitalis muscle
parts.action: Pulls the scalp back and tightens it.
parts.origin: Superior nuchal line and mastoid process
parts.insertion: Epicranial aponeurosis (galea)

parts.name: Epicranial aponeurosis
parts.action: Joins the frontalis and occipitalis across the top of the skull.
parts.insertion: Frontalis muscle (soft tissue)

parts.name: Temporoparietalis muscle
parts.action: Tightens the scalp and lifts the ear slightly.
parts.origin: Temporal fascia above the ear (soft tissue)
parts.insertion: Epicranial aponeurosis (galea)

parts.name: Nasalis muscle
parts.action: Flares and compresses the nostrils.
parts.insertion: Nasal bridge aponeurosis and nostril cartilage

parts.name: Orbital part of orbicularis oculi
parts.action: Squeezes the eyelids tightly shut.
parts.origin: Medial orbital margin and medial palpebral ligament
parts.insertion: Skin around the orbit

parts.name: Palpebral part of orbicularis oculi
parts.action: Closes the eyelids gently in blinking.
parts.insertion: Lateral palpebral raphe

parts.name: Orbicularis oris muscle
parts.action: Closes and purses the lips.
parts.origin: Muscles around mouth, maxilla and mandible
parts.insertion: Skin and mucosa of the lips

parts.name: Zygomaticus major muscle
parts.action: Lifts the corner of the mouth up and back to smile.
parts.insertion: Skin at the corner of the mouth

parts.name: Depressor anguli oris
parts.action: Pulls the corner of the mouth down.
parts.insertion: Skin at the corner of the mouth

parts.name: Depressor labii inferioris
parts.action: Pulls the lower lip down and sideways.
parts.insertion: Skin and mucosa of the lower lip

parts.name: Procerus muscle
parts.action: Pulls the eyebrow down and wrinkles the nose bridge.
parts.insertion: Skin between the eyebrows

parts.name: Risorius muscle
parts.action: Pulls the corner of the mouth sideways.
parts.insertion: Skin at the corner of the mouth

parts.name: Zygomaticus minor muscle
parts.action: Lifts the upper lip.
parts.insertion: Muscle of the upper lip

parts.name: Levator labii superioris
parts.action: Lifts the upper lip.
parts.insertion: Skin and muscle of the upper lip

parts.name: Mentalis muscle
parts.action: Raises the chin skin and pushes the lower lip out.
parts.insertion: Skin of the chin

parts.name: Levator nasolabialis
parts.action: Lifts the upper lip and flares the nostril.
parts.insertion: Upper lip and wing of the nose

parts.name: Superficial part of masseter
parts.action: Closes the jaw and pulls it forward.
parts.origin: Anterior two thirds of zygomatic arch
parts.insertion: Outer surface of mandibular angle and ramus

parts.name: Temporalis muscle
parts.action: Closes the jaw and pulls it back.
parts.insertion: Coronoid process and front edge of mandibular ramus

parts.name: Sternocleidomastoid muscle
parts.action: Turns the head to the opposite side and bends the neck.
parts.insertion: Mastoid process and superior nuchal line

parts.name: Anterior belly of digastric muscle
parts.action: Opens the jaw and raises the hyoid bone.
parts.insertion: Intermediate tendon at the hyoid bone

parts.name: Sternohyoid muscle
parts.action: Pulls the hyoid bone down.
parts.insertion: Body of hyoid bone

parts.name: Posterior layer of thoracolumbar fascia
parts.action: Transmits force between the lats, glutes and spine across the back.
parts.origin: Spinous processes of the lumbar and sacral vertebrae
parts.insertion: Covers erector spinae to the ribs and iliac crest

parts.name: Ascending part of trapezius muscle
parts.action: Lifts the shoulder blade and extends the neck.
parts.origin: Occiput, nuchal ligament, spinous process of C7
parts.insertion: Lateral third of clavicle and acromion

parts.name: Descending part of trapezius muscle
parts.action: Pulls the shoulder blade down and in.
parts.origin: Spinous processes of T7 to T12
parts.insertion: Spine of scapula, medial end

parts.name: Transverse part of trapezius muscle
parts.action: Pulls the shoulder blade toward the spine.
parts.origin: Spinous processes of C7 to T3
parts.insertion: Acromion and upper spine of scapula

parts.name: Latissimus dorsi muscle
parts.action: Pulls the arm down and back and rotates it inward.
parts.origin: T7 to sacrum via thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest, ribs
parts.insertion: Floor of humerus bicipital groove

parts.name: Clavicular head of pectoralis major muscle
parts.action: Lifts the arm forward and brings it across the chest.
parts.insertion: Humerus, lateral lip of bicipital groove

parts.name: Sternocostal head of pectoralis major muscle
parts.action: Pulls the arm across the body and turns it inward.
parts.insertion: Humerus, lateral lip of bicipital groove

parts.name: (Abdominal part of pectoralis major muscle)
parts.action: Pulls the arm down and across the body.
parts.insertion: Humerus, lateral lip of bicipital groove

parts.name: Serratus anterior muscle
parts.action: Pulls the shoulder blade forward and holds it against the ribs.
parts.origin: Outer surfaces of upper eight or nine ribs
parts.insertion: Medial border of the scapula, front surface

parts.name: Rectus abdominis muscle
parts.action: Flexes the trunk and tilts the pelvis backward.
parts.insertion: Xiphoid process and costal cartilages 5 to 7

parts.name: Inguinal ligament
parts.action: Anchors the lower abdominal wall and forms the groin crease.
parts.insertion: Pubic tubercle

parts.name: External abdominal oblique muscle
parts.action: Twists the trunk to the opposite side and flexes the spine.
parts.origin: External surfaces of lower eight ribs
parts.insertion: Iliac crest, linea alba and pubic tubercle

parts.name: Linea alba
parts.action: Midline tendon sheet joining the abdominal wall muscles.
parts.insertion: Pubic symphysis and pubic crest

parts.name: Acromial part of deltoid muscle
parts.action: Lifts the arm out to the side.
parts.insertion: Deltoid tuberosity of the humerus

parts.name: Clavicular part of deltoid muscle
parts.action: Lifts the arm forward and turns it inward.
parts.insertion: Deltoid tuberosity of the humerus

parts.name: Scapular spinal part of deltoid muscle
parts.action: Pulls the arm back and turns it outward.
parts.insertion: Deltoid tuberosity of the humerus

parts.name: Teres major muscle
parts.action: Pulls the arm back and down and turns it inward.
parts.origin: Lower lateral border of the scapula
parts.insertion: Humerus, medial lip of bicipital groove

parts.name: Long head of biceps brachii
parts.action: Bends the elbow, turns the palm up, assists the shoulder.
parts.insertion: Radial tuberosity and bicipital aponeurosis

parts.name: Short head of biceps brachii
parts.action: Bends the elbow, turns the palm up, lifts the arm forward.
parts.insertion: Radial tuberosity and bicipital aponeurosis

parts.name: Lateral head of triceps brachii
parts.action: Straightens the elbow.
parts.origin: Posterior humerus above the radial groove
parts.insertion: Olecranon of ulna via triceps tendon

parts.name: Long head of triceps brachii
parts.action: Straightens the elbow and pulls the arm back.
parts.insertion: Olecranon of ulna via triceps tendon

parts.name: Superficial head of pronator teres
parts.action: Turns the forearm palm down and helps bend the elbow.
parts.insertion: Middle of lateral radius shaft

parts.name: Humeral head of flexor carpi ulnaris
parts.action: Bends the wrist and tilts it toward the little finger side.
parts.origin: Medial epicondyle of humerus, common flexor tendon
parts.insertion: Pisiform, hamate and base of fifth metacarpal

parts.name: Ulnar head of flexor carpi ulnaris
parts.action: Bends the wrist and tilts it toward the little finger side.
parts.origin: Olecranon and posterior border of ulna
parts.insertion: Pisiform, hamate and base of fifth metacarpal

parts.name: Flexor carpi radialis
parts.action: Bends the wrist and tilts it toward the thumb side.
parts.origin: Medial epicondyle of humerus, common flexor tendon
parts.insertion: Bases of second and third metacarpals

parts.name: Palmaris longus muscle
parts.action: Weakly bends the wrist and tenses the palmar aponeurosis.
parts.origin: Medial epicondyle of humerus, common flexor tendon
parts.insertion: Flexor retinaculum and palmar aponeurosis

parts.name: Extensor digitorum
parts.action: Extends the four fingers and the wrist.
parts.origin: Lateral epicondyle of humerus, common extensor tendon
parts.insertion: Extensor expansions of fingers two to five

parts.name: Ulnar head of extensor carpi ulnaris
parts.action: Extends the wrist and tilts it toward the little finger side.
parts.insertion: Base of fifth metacarpal

parts.name: Humeral head of extensor carpi ulnaris
parts.action: Extends the wrist and tilts it toward the little finger side.
parts.origin: Lateral epicondyle of humerus, common extensor tendon
parts.insertion: Base of fifth metacarpal

parts.name: Brachioradialis muscle
parts.action: Bends the elbow, strongest with the thumb pointing up.
parts.insertion: Styloid process of radius

parts.name: Extensor carpi radialis longus
parts.action: Extends the wrist and tilts it toward the thumb side.
parts.insertion: Base of second metacarpal

parts.name: Extensor digiti minimi
parts.action: Extends the little finger.
parts.origin: Lateral epicondyle of humerus, common extensor tendon
parts.insertion: Extensor expansion of the little finger

parts.name: Superficial head of flexor pollicis brevis
parts.action: Bends the thumb at its base joint.
parts.insertion: Base of thumb proximal phalanx, radial side

parts.name: Abductor pollicis brevis
parts.action: Moves the thumb away from the palm.
parts.insertion: Radial side of thumb proximal phalanx

parts.name: Abductor digiti minimi of hand
parts.action: Spreads the little finger away from the ring finger.
parts.origin: Pisiform and tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris
parts.insertion: Base of little finger proximal phalanx

parts.name: Extensor retinaculum of wrist
parts.action: Holds the wrist and finger extensor tendons against the wrist.
parts.insertion: Ulnar styloid, triquetrum and pisiform

parts.name: Flexor retinaculum of wrist
parts.action: Roofs the carpal tunnel and holds the finger flexor tendons down.
parts.insertion: Scaphoid tubercle and trapezium

parts.name: Palmar aponeurosis
parts.action: Tightens the palm skin and aids grip.
parts.origin: Palmaris longus tendon and flexor retinaculum
parts.insertion: Bases of the fingers, flexor sheaths

parts.name: Gluteus maximus muscle
parts.action: Extends and externally rotates the hip; powers standing and sprinting.
parts.origin: Ilium behind gluteal line, sacrum, coccyx, sacrotuberous ligament
parts.insertion: Gluteal tuberosity of femur and iliotibial tract

parts.name: Tensor fasciae latae
parts.action: Flexes, abducts and medially rotates the hip; tenses the iliotibial tract.
parts.origin: Anterior superior iliac spine and iliac crest
parts.insertion: Iliotibial tract, to lateral tibial condyle

parts.name: Rectus femoris muscle
parts.action: Straightens the knee and bends the hip.
parts.origin: Anterior inferior iliac spine and above acetabulum
parts.insertion: Patella, then tibial tuberosity via patellar tendon

parts.name: Vastus lateralis muscle
parts.action: Straightens the knee.
parts.origin: Greater trochanter, linea aspera, lateral femur
parts.insertion: Patella, then tibial tuberosity via patellar tendon

parts.name: Vastus medialis muscle
parts.action: Straightens the knee and steadies the kneecap.
parts.origin: Intertrochanteric line, linea aspera, medial femur
parts.insertion: Patella, then tibial tuberosity via patellar tendon

parts.name: Sartorius muscle
parts.action: Bends the hip and knee and turns the thigh outward.
parts.insertion: Upper medial tibia (pes anserinus)

parts.name: Gracilis muscle
parts.action: Pulls the thigh inward and bends the knee.
parts.origin: Body and inferior ramus of pubis
parts.insertion: Medial surface of upper tibia (pes anserinus)

parts.name: Long head of biceps femoris
parts.action: Bends the knee and extends the hip.
parts.insertion: Head of the fibula, lateral tibial condyle

parts.name: Semitendinosus muscle
parts.action: Bends the knee and extends the hip.
parts.insertion: Upper medial tibia (pes anserinus)

parts.name: Tendon of extensor digitorum longus
parts.action: Pull the four lesser toes up as the foot lifts.
parts.origin: Extensor digitorum longus muscle belly (soft tissue)
parts.insertion: Middle and distal phalanges of lateral four toes

parts.name: Tibialis anterior muscle
parts.action: Lifts the foot upward and turns the sole inward.
parts.origin: Lateral tibial condyle and upper tibia shaft
parts.insertion: Medial cuneiform and base of first metatarsal

parts.name: Lateral head of gastrocnemius
parts.action: Points the foot down and helps bend the knee.
parts.insertion: Calcaneus via calcaneal tendon

parts.name: Medial head of gastrocnemius
parts.action: Points the foot down and helps bend the knee.
parts.origin: Medial condyle and popliteal surface of femur
parts.insertion: Calcaneus via calcaneal tendon

parts.name: Calcaneal tendon
parts.action: Transmits calf force to the heel for pointing the foot down.
parts.insertion: Posterior surface of calcaneus

parts.name: Abductor digiti minimi of foot
parts.action: Spreads the little toe outward.
parts.insertion: Lateral base of little toe proximal phalanx

parts.name: Abductor hallucis
parts.action: Pulls the big toe inward and supports the arch.
parts.insertion: Medial base of big toe proximal phalanx

parts.name: Iliotibial tract
parts.action: Stabilises the hip and knee; transmits glute max and TFL force.
parts.origin: Iliac crest; glute max and tensor fasciae latae
parts.insertion: Gerdy tubercle on lateral tibial condyle

parts.name: Superior extensor retinaculum of ankle
parts.action: Holds the shin tendons against the front of the ankle.
parts.insertion: Distal anterior tibia

parts.name: Inferior extensor retinaculum of ankle
parts.action: Holds the shin tendons down at the front of the ankle.
parts.insertion: Medial malleolus and plantar aponeurosis

parts.name: Superior fibular retinaculum
parts.action: Holds the fibularis tendons behind the outer ankle bone.
parts.insertion: Lateral calcaneus

parts.name: Inferior fibular retinaculum
parts.action: Holds the fibular tendons against the outer ankle.
parts.insertion: Inferior extensor retinaculum

parts.name: Plantar aponeurosis
parts.action: Supports the arch of the foot and tightens when toes lift.
parts.insertion: Bases of the toe phalanges

parts.name: Corrugator supercilii
parts.action: Draws the eyebrows together and down into a frown.
parts.origin: Medial end of the superciliary arch
parts.insertion: Skin of the eyebrow

parts.name: Levator anguli oris
parts.action: Lifts the corner of the mouth to smile.
parts.insertion: Skin at the corner of the mouth

parts.name: Depressor septi nasi
parts.action: Pulls the nasal septum down and narrows the nostrils.
parts.insertion: Nasal septum and ala of the nose

parts.name: Bucinator
parts.action: Presses the cheek against the teeth and aids chewing.
parts.insertion: Orbicularis oris at the corner of the mouth

parts.name: Deep part of masseter
parts.action: Closes the jaw and pulls it back slightly.
parts.insertion: Upper ramus and coronoid process of mandible

parts.name: Intermediate tendon of digastric muscle
parts.action: Links the two bellies and slides through a sling on the hyoid.
parts.insertion: Anterior belly of digastric; hyoid sling

parts.name: Posterior belly of digastric muscle
parts.action: Opens the jaw and draws the hyoid bone back and up.
parts.origin: Mastoid notch of the temporal bone
parts.insertion: Intermediate tendon at the hyoid bone

parts.name: Mylohyoid muscle
parts.action: Raises the hyoid and floor of the mouth; helps lower the jaw.
parts.insertion: Hyoid body and median raphe

parts.name: Stylohyoid muscle
parts.action: Draws the hyoid up and back during swallowing.
parts.insertion: Body of hyoid at greater horn junction

parts.name: Omohyoid muscle
parts.action: Pulls the hyoid bone down and steadies it.
parts.insertion: Body of hyoid bone

parts.name: Sternothyroid muscle
parts.action: Pulls the larynx down.
parts.origin: Back of manubrium, first costal cartilage
parts.insertion: Oblique line of thyroid cartilage (soft tissue)

parts.name: Thyrohyoid muscle
parts.action: Lifts the larynx toward the hyoid bone.
parts.origin: Oblique line of thyroid cartilage (soft tissue)
parts.insertion: Greater horn and body of hyoid bone

parts.name: Scalenus medius muscle
parts.action: Lifts the first rib and tilts the neck sideways.
parts.origin: Transverse processes of C2 to C7
parts.insertion: First rib, behind subclavian groove

parts.name: Scalenus anterior muscle
parts.action: Lifts the first rib and tilts the neck sideways.
parts.origin: Transverse processes of C3 to C6
parts.insertion: First rib, scalene tubercle

parts.name: Iliocostalis lumborum muscle
parts.action: Extends the spine and bends it sideways.
parts.insertion: Angles of the lower six ribs

parts.name: Iliocostalis thoracis muscle
parts.action: Extends the spine and keeps the upper back upright.
parts.origin: Angles of the lower six ribs
parts.insertion: Angles of upper six ribs, C7 transverse process

parts.name: Longissimus thoracis muscle
parts.action: Extends the spine and keeps the trunk upright.
parts.origin: Sacrum, iliac crest, lumbar and lower thoracic spinous processes
parts.insertion: Ribs and transverse processes of thoracic, lumbar vertebrae

parts.name: Spinalis thoracis muscle
parts.action: Extends the upper spine.
parts.origin: Spinous processes of T11 to L2
parts.insertion: Spinous processes of T1 to T8

parts.name: Splenius capitis muscle
parts.action: Extends and rotates the head to the same side.
parts.origin: Nuchal ligament, spinous processes C7 to T3
parts.insertion: Mastoid process, lateral superior nuchal line

parts.name: Splenius colli muscle
parts.action: Extends the neck and rotates it to the same side.
parts.origin: Spinous processes of T3 to T6
parts.insertion: Transverse processes of C1 to C3

parts.name: Levator scapulae
parts.action: Lifts the shoulder blade and tilts its lower tip inward.
parts.origin: Transverse processes of C1 to C4
parts.insertion: Superior angle and medial border above scapular spine

parts.name: Rhomboid major muscle
parts.action: Pulls the shoulder blade toward the spine.
parts.origin: Spinous processes of T2 to T5
parts.insertion: Medial border of scapula below its spine

parts.name: Rhomboid minor muscle
parts.action: Pulls the shoulder blade toward the spine.
parts.origin: Nuchal ligament, spines of C7 and T1
parts.insertion: Medial border of scapula at its spine

parts.name: External intercostal muscles
parts.action: Lift the ribs to help breathe in.
parts.origin: Lower border of the rib above
parts.insertion: Upper border of the rib below

parts.name: Internal abdominal oblique muscle
parts.action: Twists the trunk to the same side and flexes the spine.
parts.origin: Thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest, inguinal ligament
parts.insertion: Lower three ribs, linea alba, pubic crest

parts.name: Pyramidalis muscle
parts.action: Tenses the linea alba.
parts.insertion: Linea alba (soft tissue only)

parts.name: Teres minor muscle
parts.action: Turns the arm outward and steadies the shoulder.
parts.origin: Upper lateral border of the scapula
parts.insertion: Greater tubercle of the humerus, lower

parts.name: Infraspinatus muscle
parts.action: Turns the arm outward and steadies the shoulder.
parts.insertion: Greater tubercle of the humerus

parts.name: Brachialis muscle
parts.action: Bends the elbow in every forearm position.
parts.origin: Lower front of the humerus shaft
parts.insertion: Coronoid process and tuberosity of the ulna

parts.name: Coracobrachialis muscle
parts.action: Lifts the arm forward and pulls it toward the body.
parts.insertion: Middle of the medial humerus shaft

parts.name: Medial head of triceps brachii
parts.action: Straightens the elbow.
parts.origin: Posterior humerus below the radial groove
parts.insertion: Olecranon of ulna via triceps tendon

parts.name: Humero-ulnar head of flexor digitorum superficialis
parts.action: Bends the middle joints of the four fingers and the wrist.
parts.origin: Medial epicondyle of humerus and coronoid process of ulna
parts.insertion: Sides of middle phalanges of fingers two to five

parts.name: Radial head of flexor digitorum superficialis
parts.action: Bends the middle joints of the four fingers and the wrist.
parts.origin: Anterior oblique line of the radius
parts.insertion: Sides of middle phalanges of fingers two to five

parts.name: Extensor carpi radialis brevis
parts.action: Extends the wrist and tilts it toward the thumb side.
parts.origin: Lateral epicondyle of humerus, common extensor tendon
parts.insertion: Base of third metacarpal

parts.name: Anconeus muscle
parts.action: Extends the elbow and stabilises the ulna.
parts.insertion: Lateral olecranon and upper posterior ulna

parts.name: Abductor pollicis longus
parts.action: Moves the thumb away from the palm and tilts the wrist.
parts.origin: Posterior ulna, radius and interosseous membrane
parts.insertion: Base of the first metacarpal

parts.name: Extensor pollicis brevis
parts.action: Straightens the thumb's knuckle joint and pulls it away from the palm.
parts.insertion: Base of the thumb proximal phalanx

parts.name: Flexor digiti minimi of hand
parts.display: Flexor digiti minimi brevis of hand
parts.action: Flexes the little finger at its base joint.
parts.insertion: Base of little finger proximal phalanx

parts.name: Dorsal interossei muscles of hand
parts.action: Spread the fingers away from the middle finger.
parts.insertion: Bases of proximal phalanges, extensor expansions

parts.name: Gluteus medius muscle
parts.action: Abducts the hip and steadies the pelvis when standing on one leg.
parts.origin: Outer ilium between anterior and posterior gluteal lines
parts.insertion: Lateral surface of greater trochanter

parts.name: Adductor magnus
parts.action: Pulls the thigh inward; the hamstring part extends the hip.
parts.origin: Inferior pubic ramus, ischial ramus, ischial tuberosity
parts.insertion: Linea aspera and adductor tubercle of femur

parts.name: Adductor longus
parts.action: Pulls the thigh inward and helps flex it.
parts.origin: Body of pubis below pubic crest
parts.insertion: Middle third of linea aspera of femur

parts.name: Pectineus muscle
parts.action: Flexes the hip and pulls the thigh inward.
parts.insertion: Pectineal line below lesser trochanter of femur

parts.name: Short head of biceps femoris
parts.action: Bends the knee and turns the shin outward.
parts.origin: Lateral lip of the linea aspera
parts.insertion: Head of the fibula, lateral tibial condyle

parts.name: Semimembranosus muscle
parts.action: Bends the knee and extends the hip.
parts.insertion: Back of the medial tibial condyle

parts.name: Extensor digitorum longus
parts.action: Lifts the four lesser toes and the foot upward.
parts.origin: Lateral tibial condyle, upper fibula, interosseous membrane
parts.insertion: Middle and distal phalanges of toes 2-5

parts.name: Fibularis tertius muscle
parts.action: Lifts the foot upward and turns the sole outward.
parts.insertion: Dorsal base of the fifth metatarsal

parts.name: Fibularis longus muscle
parts.action: Turns the foot outward and supports the arch.
parts.origin: Head and upper lateral shaft of fibula
parts.insertion: Medial cuneiform and first metatarsal base

parts.name: Fibularis brevis muscle
parts.action: Turns the foot outward and helps point the toes.
parts.origin: Lower two thirds of lateral fibula
parts.insertion: Tuberosity of fifth metatarsal base

parts.name: Soleus muscle
parts.action: Points the foot down; keeps the body upright when standing.
parts.origin: Soleal line of tibia, head and upper shaft of fibula
parts.insertion: Calcaneus via calcaneal tendon

parts.name: Extensor digitorum brevis
parts.action: Extends toes 2 to 4 at the knuckle joints.
parts.insertion: Tendons of extensor digitorum longus, toes 2 to 4

parts.name: Extensor hallucis brevis
parts.action: Extends the big toe at its base joint.
parts.insertion: Base of big toe proximal phalanx

parts.name: Dorsal interossei muscles of foot
parts.action: Abduct toes 2 to 4 about the second toe and flex their base joints.
parts.insertion: Bases of proximal phalanges of toes 2 to 4

parts.name: Flexor digitorum brevis
parts.action: Flexes toes 2 to 5 and supports the arch.
parts.insertion: Middle phalanges of toes 2 to 5

parts.name: Flexor retinaculum of ankle
parts.action: Holds the deep calf tendons against the inner ankle.
parts.insertion: Calcaneus, medial surface

parts.name: Medial pterygoid muscle
parts.action: Closes the jaw and moves it sideways.
parts.origin: Lateral pterygoid plate (medial surface), palatine bone
parts.insertion: Inner surface of mandibular angle

parts.name: Inferior head of lateral pterygoid muscle
parts.action: Opens the jaw, protrudes it and moves it sideways.
parts.origin: Outer surface of lateral pterygoid plate
parts.insertion: Neck of mandibular condyle

parts.name: Superior head of lateral pterygoid muscle
parts.action: Stabilises the jaw joint disc when the jaw closes.
parts.origin: Infratemporal surface of greater wing of sphenoid
parts.insertion: Joint capsule and articular disc of jaw joint

parts.name: Geniohyoid muscle
parts.action: Pulls the hyoid forward and up; helps open the jaw.
parts.insertion: Anterior surface of hyoid body

parts.name: Scalenus posterior muscle
parts.action: Lifts the second rib and tilts the neck sideways.
parts.origin: Transverse processes of C4 to C6
parts.insertion: Outer surface of second rib

parts.name: Longus capitis muscle
parts.action: Bends the head and upper neck forward.
parts.origin: Transverse processes of C3 to C6
parts.insertion: Basilar part of occipital bone

parts.name: Longus colli muscle
parts.action: Bends the neck forward and helps tilt it sideways.
parts.origin: Front of C3 to T3 vertebral bodies
parts.insertion: Atlas front arch, C2 to C6 vertebrae

parts.name: Rectus anterior capitis muscle
parts.action: Nods the head forward at the top of the neck.
parts.insertion: Basilar part of occipital bone

parts.name: Rectus lateralis capitis muscle
parts.action: Tilts the head sideways and steadies it.
parts.insertion: Jugular process of occipital bone

parts.name: Obliquus inferior capitis muscle
parts.action: Rotates the atlas, turning the head to the same side.
parts.insertion: Transverse process of atlas (C1)

parts.name: Obliquus superior capitis muscle
parts.action: Extends the head and tilts it to the same side.
parts.insertion: Occipital bone, between superior and inferior nuchal lines

parts.name: Rectus posterior major capitis muscle
parts.action: Extends the head and rotates it to the same side.
parts.insertion: Occipital bone, inferior nuchal line, lateral part

parts.name: Rectus posterior minor capitis muscle
parts.action: Extends the head at the skull base.
parts.insertion: Occipital bone, inferior nuchal line, medial part

parts.name: Iliocostalis colli muscle
parts.action: Extends and bends the neck to its own side.
parts.insertion: Transverse processes of C4 to C6

parts.name: Longissimus capitis muscle
parts.action: Extends and rotates the head to the same side.
parts.origin: Transverse processes of upper thoracic, lower cervical vertebrae
parts.insertion: Mastoid process of the skull

parts.name: Longissimus colli muscle
parts.action: Extends and side-bends the neck.
parts.origin: Transverse processes of upper thoracic vertebrae
parts.insertion: Transverse processes of C2 to C6

parts.name: Spinalis capitis muscle
parts.action: Extends the head and neck.
parts.origin: Upper thoracic transverse processes, lower cervical articular processes
parts.insertion: Occipital bone, between nuchal lines

parts.name: Spinalis colli muscle
parts.action: Extends the neck.
parts.origin: Nuchal ligament, spinous process of C7
parts.insertion: Spinous process of the axis (C2)

parts.name: Multifidus colli muscle
parts.action: Extends and rotates the neck, steadying the vertebrae.
parts.origin: Articular processes of C4 to C7
parts.insertion: Spinous processes of cervical vertebrae above

parts.name: Multifidus thoracis muscle
parts.action: Steadies and extends the mid-spine, rotating it slightly.
parts.insertion: Spinous processes two to four vertebrae above

parts.name: Multifidus lumborum muscle
parts.action: Steadies and extends the lower spine, rotating it slightly.
parts.origin: Sacrum, iliac spine, lumbar mamillary processes
parts.insertion: Spinous processes of lumbar vertebrae above

parts.name: Semispinalis thoracis muscle
parts.action: Extends and rotates the upper spine.
parts.origin: Transverse processes of T6 to T10
parts.insertion: Spinous processes of C6 to T4

parts.name: Semispinalis colli muscle
parts.action: Extends and rotates the neck.
parts.origin: Transverse processes of T1 to T6
parts.insertion: Spinous processes of C2 to C5

parts.name: Rotatores
parts.action: Rotate and extend the spine, sensing its position.
parts.insertion: Lamina of the vertebra above

parts.name: Interspinales colli muscles
parts.action: Extends the neck and steadies the vertebrae.
parts.origin: Spinous process of a cervical vertebra
parts.insertion: Spinous process of vertebra above

parts.name: Interspinales thoracis muscles
parts.action: Extends the thoracic spine and steadies the vertebrae.
parts.origin: Spinous process of a thoracic vertebra
parts.insertion: Spinous process of vertebra above

parts.name: Interspinales lumborum muscles
parts.action: Extends the lumbar spine and steadies the vertebrae.
parts.origin: Spinous process of a lumbar vertebra
parts.insertion: Spinous process of vertebra above

parts.name: Dorsal parts of lateral intertransversarii lumborum muscles
parts.action: Bends the lumbar spine sideways.
parts.insertion: Accessory process of vertebra above

parts.name: Ventral parts of lateral intertransversarii lumborum muscles
parts.action: Bends the lumbar spine sideways.
parts.insertion: Transverse process of vertebra above

parts.name: Serratus posterior inferior muscle
parts.action: Pulls the lower ribs down and back during breathing.
parts.origin: Spines of T11 to L2, thoracolumbar fascia
parts.insertion: Lower borders of ribs 9 to 12

parts.name: Serratus posterior superior muscle
parts.action: Lifts the upper ribs during breathing.
parts.origin: Nuchal ligament, spines of C7 to T3
parts.insertion: Upper borders of ribs 2 to 5

parts.name: Levatores longi costarum
parts.action: Lift the rib two levels down and extend the spine.
parts.origin: Transverse process of T7 to T10
parts.insertion: Rib two levels below, near the angle

parts.name: Levatores breves costarum
parts.action: Lift the rib below and help extend the spine.
parts.origin: Transverse process of C7 to T11
parts.insertion: Rib immediately below, near the angle

parts.name: Pectoralis minor muscle
parts.action: Pulls the shoulder blade forward and down.
parts.insertion: Coracoid process of the scapula

parts.name: Subclavius muscle
parts.action: Pulls the collarbone down and steadies it.
parts.insertion: Underside of the middle clavicle

parts.name: Transversus abdominis muscle
parts.action: Compresses the abdomen and braces the trunk.
parts.origin: Lower six costal cartilages, thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest
parts.insertion: Linea alba and pubic crest

parts.name: Quadratus lumborum muscle
parts.action: Side-bends the trunk and steadies the 12th rib.
parts.insertion: 12th rib and lumbar transverse processes

parts.name: Subscapularis muscle
parts.action: Turns the arm inward and steadies the shoulder.
parts.insertion: Lesser tubercle of the humerus

parts.name: Supraspinatus muscle
parts.action: Starts lifting the arm out to the side.
parts.insertion: Greater tubercle of the humerus, top

parts.name: Deep head of pronator teres
parts.action: Turns the forearm palm down and helps bend the elbow.
parts.insertion: Middle of lateral radius shaft

parts.name: Flexor digitorum profundus
parts.action: Bends the fingertips and helps flex the wrist.
parts.insertion: Distal phalanges of fingers 2-5

parts.name: Flexor pollicis longus
parts.action: Bends the tip of the thumb.
parts.insertion: Distal phalanx of the thumb

parts.name: Pronator quadratus
parts.action: Turns the forearm so the palm faces down.
parts.insertion: Distal anterior radius

parts.name: Supinator
parts.action: Turns the forearm so the palm faces up.
parts.origin: Lateral epicondyle and supinator crest of the ulna
parts.insertion: Upper lateral shaft of the radius

parts.name: Extensor indicis
parts.action: Straightens the index finger independently.
parts.origin: Posterior distal ulna and interosseous membrane
parts.insertion: Extensor expansion of the index finger

parts.name: Extensor pollicis longus
parts.action: Straightens the tip of the thumb.
parts.origin: Posterior middle ulna and interosseous membrane
parts.insertion: Distal phalanx of the thumb

parts.name: Deep head of flexor pollicis brevis
parts.action: Flexes the thumb at its base joint.
parts.insertion: Base of thumb proximal phalanx

parts.name: Oblique head of adductor pollicis
parts.action: Pulls the thumb toward the palm for grip.
parts.origin: Capitate and bases of metacarpals 2 and 3
parts.insertion: Base of thumb proximal phalanx

parts.name: Transverse head of adductor pollicis
parts.action: Pulls the thumb toward the palm for pinch and grip.
parts.origin: Shaft of third metacarpal, palmar surface
parts.insertion: Base of thumb proximal phalanx, ulnar side

parts.name: Opponens pollicis muscle
parts.action: Draws the thumb across the palm to meet the fingers.
parts.insertion: First metacarpal, radial border

parts.name: Opponens digiti minimi muscle of hand
parts.action: Draws the little finger across the palm toward the thumb.
parts.insertion: Fifth metacarpal, ulnar border

parts.name: Lumbrical muscles of hand
parts.action: Bend finger knuckles while straightening the finger tips.
parts.origin: Tendons of flexor digitorum profundus (soft tissue)
parts.insertion: Extensor expansions of fingers 2 to 5

parts.name: Palmar interossei muscles
parts.action: Pull the fingers toward the middle finger and help bend the knuckles.
parts.insertion: Base of proximal phalanx, extensor expansion

parts.name: Iliacus muscle
parts.action: Bends the hip and tilts the pelvis forward.
parts.origin: Iliac fossa and ala of sacrum
parts.insertion: Lesser trochanter via psoas tendon

parts.name: Psoas major
parts.action: Bends the hip and flexes the lumbar spine.
parts.origin: Sides of T12 to L5 vertebrae and discs
parts.insertion: Lesser trochanter of femur

parts.name: Gluteus minimus muscle
parts.action: Abducts and medially rotates the hip; steadies the pelvis.
parts.origin: Outer ilium between anterior and inferior gluteal lines
parts.insertion: Anterior surface of greater trochanter

parts.name: Piriformis muscle
parts.action: Turns the thigh outward and abducts it when the hip is bent.
parts.insertion: Upper greater trochanter of the femur

parts.name: Quadratus femoris muscle
parts.action: Turns the thigh outward and steadies the hip.
parts.insertion: Intertrochanteric crest of the femur

parts.name: Inferior gemellus muscle
parts.action: Turns the thigh outward and steadies the hip joint.
parts.insertion: Greater trochanter via obturator internus tendon

parts.name: Obturator internus
parts.action: Turns the thigh outward and steadies the hip joint.
parts.origin: Inner obturator membrane and surrounding pelvic bone
parts.insertion: Medial greater trochanter of the femur

parts.name: Superior gemellus muscle
parts.action: Turns the thigh outward and steadies the hip joint.
parts.insertion: Greater trochanter via obturator internus tendon

parts.name: Vastus intermedius muscle
parts.action: Straightens the knee.
parts.origin: Front and lateral shaft of the femur
parts.insertion: Patella, then tibial tuberosity via patellar tendon

parts.name: Adductor brevis
parts.action: Pulls the thigh inward and helps flex it.
parts.origin: Body and inferior ramus of pubis
parts.insertion: Upper part of linea aspera of femur

parts.name: (Adductor minimus)
parts.action: Pulls the thigh inward and helps rotate it outward.
parts.origin: Inferior pubic ramus and ischial ramus
parts.insertion: Upper linea aspera of the femur

parts.name: Obturator externus
parts.action: Turns the thigh outward and steadies the hip.
parts.origin: Outer surface of obturator membrane and pubic rami
parts.insertion: Trochanteric fossa of femur

parts.name: Extensor hallucis longus
parts.action: Lifts the big toe and helps raise the foot.
parts.insertion: Distal phalanx of the big toe

parts.name: Plantaris muscle
parts.action: Weakly points the foot down and helps bend the knee.
parts.insertion: Calcaneus, medial to calcaneal tendon

parts.name: Flexor digitorum longus
parts.action: Curls the four lesser toes and points the foot.
parts.insertion: Distal phalanges of toes 2-5

parts.name: Popliteus muscle
parts.action: Unlocks the straight knee by turning the thigh outward on the shin.
parts.insertion: Posterior upper tibia

parts.name: Tibialis posterior muscle
parts.action: Turns the sole inward and points the foot.
parts.origin: Posterior tibia, fibula and interosseous membrane
parts.insertion: Navicular, cuneiforms, cuboid, bases of metatarsals 2-4

parts.name: Flexor hallucis longus
parts.action: Curls the big toe and points the foot.
parts.insertion: Distal phalanx of the big toe

parts.name: Medial head of flexor hallucis brevis
parts.action: Bends the big toe at its base joint.
parts.insertion: Medial side of big toe proximal phalanx

parts.name: Lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis
parts.action: Bends the big toe at its base joint.
parts.insertion: Lateral side of big toe proximal phalanx

parts.name: Oblique head of adductor hallucis
parts.action: Pulls the big toe toward the second toe and braces the arch.
parts.origin: Bases of metatarsals 2-4, cuboid, lateral cuneiform
parts.insertion: Lateral base of big toe proximal phalanx

parts.name: Transverse head of adductor hallucis
parts.action: Squeezes the forefoot together and pulls the big toe inward.
parts.origin: Plantar ligaments of toes 3-5 metatarsophalangeal joints
parts.insertion: Lateral base of big toe proximal phalanx

parts.name: Flexor digiti minimi of foot
parts.display: Flexor digiti minimi brevis of foot
parts.action: Flexes the little toe.
parts.origin: Base of fifth metatarsal, long plantar ligament
parts.insertion: Base of little toe proximal phalanx

parts.name: Lumbrical muscles of foot
parts.action: Flex toe knuckles and straighten the toe tips.
parts.origin: Tendons of flexor digitorum longus (soft tissue)
parts.insertion: Extensor expansions of toes 2 to 5

parts.name: (Opponens digiti minimi muscle of foot)
parts.action: Draws the fifth metatarsal toward the sole.
parts.origin: Long plantar ligament, sheath of fibularis longus
parts.insertion: Fifth metatarsal

parts.name: Plantar interossei muscles
parts.action: Draw toes 3 to 5 toward the second toe.
parts.insertion: Bases of proximal phalanges of toes 3 to 5

parts.name: Quadratus plantae muscle
parts.action: Straightens the pull of the long toe flexor.
parts.origin: Medial and lateral surfaces of calcaneus
parts.insertion: Tendon of flexor digitorum longus (soft tissue)

parts.name: Mammary gland
parts.action: Gland and fat lying on the fascia over pectoralis major and serratus anterior, from the second rib to the sixth. Not a muscle: the chest wall carries it.
parts.over: Sternocostal head of pectoralis major muscle
